messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm rolling out the new runtime/dashboard tiles for request_latency_p50/p95, kv_cache_hit_ratio, and model_fallbacks. Need to lock alerting thresholds and oncall routing before I flip to prod.
leo: OK. Can you paste the paired panels so we can decide burn-rate vs instantaneous thresholds? I want to avoid noisy P95 pages.
anya: On runtime side we'll emit both p50/p95 histograms and a 5m burn-rate gauge for latency regression. Expect a new metric name: runtime_latency_burnrate{route,model,region} by EOD.
jules: For paging, prefer a burn-rate alert that aggregates per-service (route) with cooldown + grouping; instant p95 pages are too chatty unless sustained >5m.
sam: Agreed. Routing preference: primary pager -> runtime oncall, secondary -> eng-platform. We should also include mute windows for known traffic bursts (deploys). Who owns the routing mapping?
maria: @sam owns the oncall mapping. @leo can you propose the Prometheus alert rule shapes? Also need a low-sev Slack notify for kv_cache_hit_ratio dips.
leo: Draft rules below. Thoughts?

```
- alert: RuntimeLatencyBurnRateHigh
  expr: rate(runtime_latency_burnrate[5m]) > 0.2
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
    team: runtime
  annotations:
    summary: "High runtime latency burn rate for {{ $labels.route }}"
    runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-latency"

- alert: KVCacheHitRatioLow
  expr: avg_over_time(kv_cache_hit_ratio[10m]) < 0.6
  for: 15m
  labels:
    severity: ticket
    team: platform
  annotations:
    summary: "Low KV cache hit ratio on {{ $labels.region }}"
    runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache"
```

anya: These look good. For the burn-rate expr we'll need to normalize by baseline (traffic per route). Otherwise small routes will trigger. Suggest `rate(runtime_latency_burnrate[5m]) / max(rate(requests_total[5m]), 1)` and a route min-traffic clause.
jules: +1. Also add a dedupe key: `group_by: [route, region]` in PagerDuty mapping, otherwise pages spread too thin.
sam: For pager mapping: primary = team:runtime oncall, escalation 10m to team:platform oncall. Low-sev (ticket) -> #platform-alerts Slack + ticket to Jira component RED-INF.
maria: Also need UX hooks: when an alert triggers we want the Console rollout UI to show affected routes/models and last 30s of KV hits so SRE can triage without switching tools. @anya can runtime include a short JSON payload in the alert annotation with `top_route_examples`? Keep it small.
anya: We can include a compressed JSON snippet up to 2k chars in annotations, listing top 3 routes by latency. Will add a helper in the agent that computes `top_route_examples`.
leo: One more: quota/backpressure fallback metric. If model_fallback_rate > 0.05 sustained for 15m, that should be a page (possible capacity regression).

```
- alert: ModelFallbacksSustained
  expr: avg_over_time(model_fallback_rate[15m]) > 0.05
  for: 15m
  labels:
    severity: page
    team: runtime
  annotations:
    summary: "Sustained model fallback rate >5% on {{ $labels.route }}"
    runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-fallbacks"
```

sam: Can we add an auto-mute rule for deploy windows? Maybe tag alerts with `deploy=true` during rollout and have a 30m auto-mute per route if deploy window is set.
jules: We'll add `deploy` tag in the deploy pipeline step. Pager policy will ignore page alerts with `deploy=true` unless severity=critical.
maria: Action items:
- anya: emit burnrate gauge + top_route_examples annotation (ETA EOD)
- leo: PR for Prom rules including normalization and group_by (ETA tomorrow AM)
- jules: update PD mapping to group pages by route and add deploy ignore rule (ETA tomorrow)
- sam: update oncall rota mapping + Slack notify channel + Jira component (ETA EOD)
- maria: update Console to surface annotations + quick links to runbooks (ETA next sprint)

sam: I'll also add a short runbook stub and link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/incident-runtime-latency
maria: Thanks all — I'll hold the dashboard toggle until we confirm rules and PD mapping. Ping here when PRs landed.
deploy-bot: Deployment to staging succeeded: runtime-metrics-emitter v2.3.0 :white_check_mark:
leo: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/alerts/pull/421 — includes normalization and grouping. PTAL.
maria: Noted. I'll review after lunch.
